text.title: Index Budget Record — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: an Index Budget Record as YAML or JSON, stating what each tier costs, what an entry may contain, and when a tier splits. Machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: What the hierarchy indexes, in one line.
Number of leaves the hierarchy must reach.
Median delivered body, from the upstream cost ledger. The ceiling is set against this, not against a context-window size.
Maximum cost of ONE index read at any level (r1).
Ordered, root first. Each item: `name`, `entry_count`, `read_tokens` (measured, not estimated), `partition_key` (null at the leaf-most index).
Number of index reads a cold lookup pays. Depth is the expensive dimension (r3).
Entries per index at the widest level. `fanout^max_depth` must reach `corpus_size`.
Per-entry cap on the one free-text field. Above ~120 characters an entry has become a description (r2).
Closed list of what an entry may carry — typically `id`, routing keys, `discriminator`.
Fields that MUST NOT appear in any index entry. Must include the leaf's full summary or description field (r2).
Index size at which a level splits. Must be at or below `index_read_ceiling_tokens` (r4).
Must be `true`: a split leaves a stub at the original path so caller routing is unchanged (r4).
Does a natural partition key already exist? Decides whether any build is authorised at all (r5).
`shard` is free. `recursive_summary` is permitted only when `corpus_nests_naturally` is false.
One-off construction cost. Must be `0` for `shard`, and above `0` for any pattern involving summarisation (r5).
What invalidates the index and how it is rebuilt incrementally. Required whenever `build_tokens` is above zero.
Must be `true`. A known leaf path is read directly (r6).

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: `len(levels)` equals `max_depth`. Every level's `read_tokens` is at or below `index_read_ceiling_tokens`; a level above it is reported with the shard that fixes it. `fanout ** max_depth >= corpus_size`, or leaves are unreachable. The full cold walk — `sum(read_tokens) + median_body_tokens` — is reported, and the walk portion must not exceed the median body: a map costlier than its destination fails r1. Every level except the last declares a `partition_key`. `leaf_owns` and `entry_fields` are disjoint.

section.title: Handoff
section.statement: This record is downstream of a Retrieval Cost Ledger and upstream of nothing. After the compression lands, re-run the audit on the same ten queries: the record predicts a new index share, and the ledger is what confirms it. A record whose predicted saving is never verified is a plan, not a result.
